text: function calculates following metrics. Endemism-weighted versions metrics available. metrics weighted occurrence probability abundance, applicable. Richness measures: TD—Terminal Diversity, .e. richness terminal taxa (many cases species): \(\sum_{t}{p_t}\) TE—Terminal Endemism, .e. total endemism-weighted diversity terminal taxa, .k.. "weighted endemism": \(\sum_{t}{p_t r_t^{-1}}\) CD—Clade Diversity, .e. richness taxa levels (equivalent PD cladogram): \(\sum_{b}{p_b}\) CE—Clade Endemism, .e. total endemism-weighted diversity taxa levels (equivalent PE cladrogram): \(\sum_{b}{p_b r_b^{-1}}\) PD—Phylogenetic Diversity, .e. total branch length occurring site: \(\sum_{b}{L_b p_b}\) PE—Phylogenetic Endemism, .e. endemism-weighted PD: \(\sum_{b}{L_b p_b r_b^{-1}}\) ShPD—Shannon Phylogenetic Diversity, .k.. "phylogenetic entropy" (version log "effective diversity" version based Hill numbers): \(-\sum_{b}{L_b n_b log(n_b)}\) ShPE—Shannon phylogenetic Endemism, endemism-weighted version ShPD: \(-\sum_{b}{L_b n_b log(e_b) r_b^{-1}}\) SiPD—Simpson Phylogenetic Diversity: \(1 / \sum_{b}{L_b n_b^2}\) SiPE—Simpson Phylogenetic Endemism, endemism-weighted version SiPD: \(1 / \sum_{b}{L_b r_b^{-1} e_b^2}\) Divergence measures: RPD—Relative Phylogenetic Diversity, .e. mean branch segment length (equivalent PD / CR): \(\sum_{b}{L_b p_b} / \sum_{b}{p_b}\) RPE—Relative Phylogenetic Endemism, .e. mean endemism-weighted branch segment length (equivalent PE / CE): \(\sum_{b}{L_b p_b r_b^{-1}} / \sum_{b}{p_b r_b^{-1}}\) MPDT—Mean Pairwise Distance Terminals, .e. classic MPD metric. average cophenetic distances, weighted \(p_t\). MPDN—Mean Pairwise Distance Nodes, experimental version MPD considers distances every pair non-nested clades, putting weight deeper branches MPDT. mean distances collateral (non-lineal) node pairs including terminal internal nodes, weighted \(p_b\). Note divergence can also assessed using ps_rand() run null model analyses richness measures like PD. Regularity measures: VPDT—Variance Pairwise Distances Terminals, .e. classic VPD metric, weighted \(p_t\). VPDN—Variance Pairwise Distances Nodes, .e.
